kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستسأل (form X)
# أُسْتَسْأَلُ (ʔustasʔalu) /ʔus.tas.ʔa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
# أُسْتَسْأَلَ (ʔustasʔala) /ʔus.tas.ʔa.la/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
# أُسْتَسْأَلْ (ʔustasʔal) /ʔus.tas.ʔal/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
